description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generated alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application from Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.7.18 to Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.0+, including the javax.* to jakarta.* namespace migration
tasks.reason: Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.x are end-of-life per organizational policy. Java 25 is the latest LTS target and Spring Boot 4.0+ is the organizational standard required to support it.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Java from 8 to 25 and Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to 4.0+. This includes the javax.* to jakarta.* namespace migration, the corresponding Spring Framework upgrade, updating Maven compiler settings for Java 25, and updating the Dockerfile to use the organizational standard Java 25 base images (mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu for build, mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless for runtime). The max supported upgrade path configuration is overridden per user directive.
